## Questions clients ask {#faq}

### What clients do you serve?

Any organisation where software has to be secure, correct and trustworthy, from
start-ups and SMEs to large enterprises, research institutions and the public sector.
Typical clients come from healthcare and medical technology, critical infrastructure,
industry and manufacturing, finance and insurance, and software vendors who need an
independent security review. If mistakes in your system are expensive, we should talk.

### Do you serve hospitals?

Yes. Our track record includes monti, an AI-based patient-monitoring platform that I
developed at University Hospital Düsseldorf, published in *European Heart Journal –
Digital Health*. For hospitals and university clinics we build clinical data science and
AI, GDPR-compliant on-premises LLM and RAG systems, clinical front-ends with access
control and audit trails, and we review the security of clinical IT.

### Do you serve critical infrastructure (KRITIS) operators?

Yes. We carry out security audits, penetration tests and vulnerability research for
operators and suppliers in energy, water, transport, healthcare and other KRITIS
sectors, aligned with NIS2 and IEC 62443. Our track record includes a high-severity
vulnerability in mission-critical software used in highest-tier security environments,
found and responsibly disclosed.

### Do you help in the development of medical-grade devices?

Yes. We have built MDR-compliant medical software since 2022 and support device makers
across the lifecycle: software architecture and implementation, cybersecurity risk
assessment and threat modelling, security testing, reverse engineering of existing
firmware, and documentation that supports your MDR or FDA technical file.

### Can you develop for embedded systems?

Yes! We write firmware and embedded software in Rust and C/C++ for microcontrollers such
as the ESP32. One example is my [Corne ergonomic keyboard with two PSP joysticks as dual
trackpoints](/posts/corne-psp/): I designed, wired and built it, and wrote the firmware
from scratch in Rust ([RMK](https://github.com/Quoteme/corne-rmk)), because no existing
firmware supported two joysticks. It works wired and wireless. For security-critical
devices we hold embedded code to high-security standards: memory-safe Rust, threat
modelling, security review and formal verification in Lean 4, so that critical
components are provably correct, secure and bug-free with respect to their
specification, not just tested.

### Do you offer tutoring in mathematics and computer science?

Yes. Tutoring is led by me, with an M.Sc. in Mathematics, a B.Sc. in Mathematics and a
B.Sc. in Computer Science. We tutor pupils at Gymnasium, vocational school and beyond
(fundamentals, Abitur preparation) as well as university students in linear algebra,
analysis, algebra, algebraic geometry, topology, type theory, probability theory, operating systems, functional and logic programming,
machine learning and more. Whether you need an intensive crash course right before an
exam or long-term preparation for top grades, we adapt to your pace and goals: working
through exercises together, explaining complex theory clearly and preparing you
specifically for your exam.

### Can you work with sensitive patient or company data?

Yes. We design for data minimisation, access control and auditability, and can deploy
AI systems such as RAG and LLMs on-premises so sensitive data stays in your network.
We can sign an NDA before reviewing project details.

### Do you offer penetration testing?

Yes. We test web apps, APIs, desktop software, firmware and devices the way an attacker
would, under a written scope and authorisation. You get prioritised findings with
reproduction steps and concrete fixes; vulnerabilities in third-party products are
handled through coordinated, responsible disclosure.

### Do you take on small, clearly scoped projects?

Yes. An engagement can begin with a security review, feasibility assessment, prototype
or fixed-scope development task. After the free call, you receive a written proposal
with scope, timeline and price.

### Do you work remotely or on-site?

Both. Most work can be delivered remotely across Germany and Europe. On-site work is
also possible; travel and on-site costs are quoted separately based on the location
and duration of the engagement.

### What do you deliver?

Depending on the engagement: actionable audit findings, production-ready code in your
repository, reproducible analysis, tests, documentation and a handover your team can
operate independently. We can also deliver complete applications, including backend,
deployment and server setup. If you would like ongoing operation, updates or support,
maintenance fees may apply and are agreed in advance.

## Locations {#locations}

Based in Düsseldorf, on-site in the Rhine-Ruhr region, the Netherlands and Belgium,
remote or on-site across the EU.

:::
